eval_rmse: RMS of observed-minus-predicted gap over case evaluation years. For true California policy evaluation, this is a policy-gap deviation statistic, NOT observed prediction error in Y(0). Use evaluation_role and eval_gap_rms.
eval_mspe: Mean squared gap. For California post-policy, used descriptively in placebo ratio; not known counterfactual prediction MSE.
post_mspe: Mean squared 1989-2000 gap; a placebo deviation statistic, with role specified by case.
eval_gap_rms: Role-neutral alias for square root of mean squared evaluation gap.
eval_mean_abs_gap: Role-neutral alias for mean absolute evaluation gap.
RMSE_in_validation_case_metrics: Genuine observed-outcome holdout error for pre-policy California / donor validation, conditional on contemporaneous donors being available.
